intro: A cryptic musty scroll provides the final set of verse left behind by Cortello. The rhyming instructions direct treasure hunters far north to the troubled continent of Lordaeron, where the trail reaches its conclusion along the coastal waterfalls of the Hinterlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To Lordaeron! The great land of turmoil
Where brave soldiers with death do toil
Find your way through the great unrest
There you will find the end to this quest
Along the coast of the Hinterlands, at the base of the great falls
Underneath the water there does your treasure call!
